tasks.answer: DeleteDiscussion is the delete-discussion confirmation control (required prop: id). It wraps ConfirmationDialog from '@/components/ui/dialog' (required props: triggerButton, confirmButton, title) and renders it only for ROLES.ADMIN via Authorization. For a generic confirmation dialog outside this feature, use ConfirmationDialog directly.

LoginForm imports { Form, Input } from '@/components/ui/form' and binds react-hook-form by passing registration={register('email')} and registration={register('password')}; Input spreads {...registration} onto the native <input>. Required prop: registration (Partial<UseFormRegisterReturn>); label and error are optional FieldWrapper pass-throughs.

DiscussionsList passes a pagination object to Table, which renders TablePagination. TablePagination requires totalPages, currentPage and rootUrl (hrefs are `${rootUrl}?page=N`). It is not re-exported from '@/components/ui/table' (index only exports ./table), so import from '@/components/ui/table/pagination'. Table itself takes data and columns (pagination optional).

MDPreview parses Markdown with marked, sanitizes it with DOMPurify and renders it through dangerouslySetInnerHTML; it takes a single required string prop, value (used in DiscussionView as value={discussion.body}).

CreateDiscussion is a FormDrawer form with Title and Markdown Body fields; it takes no props and is wrapped in Authorization allowedRoles={[ROLES.ADMIN]} from '@/lib/authorization', so only ADMIN users see the Create Discussion trigger.
